purpose: Test whether fixed corrections without additional training replace the N3 accuracy gain

SUBPIX.fallback: unsupported/missing/outside initial, too-small image, OpenCV exception, nonfinite or outside refined output

CVRANK.finite_outside_selected_candidates: retained as in original selector; no new candidate-bound gate
CVRANK.missing_direction_neighbors: prediction-support false, missing sentinel or nonfinite become NaN for edge directions only

CAP1.applied_to: same algorithm native result; no additional image/candidate computation

source_calibration.separate_manual_override_evidence: none in the frozen lock/config and source-grid comparison; radius12 was instructed

methods.import_effects: legacy sys.path insertion and definitions/constants; no top-level file read/write, GT load, inference or training

baseline.linked_N0: NOT_LINKED: not present in the same saved baseline packet

evaluation.pose: unchanged prediction-only WD hypotheses + SQPnP + refinement, actual final F(q)
evaluation.pose_reference: existing reconstructed geometry reference, not independent measured range
evaluation.ADD: ADDsym over 8 cuboid corners/proper rotation group; not surface ADD-S
evaluation.normalized_ADD_AUC: existing threshold0..0.1 /1001 trapezoidal curve, full319 including failures
evaluation.failures: full319 denominator retained; successful-pose med/P90 labeled conditional
